svg.title: Castaway: #castaway on AtollNet
svg.desc: A 9x-style IRC client window. A bot pastes a colour-cell picture of a tiny island with one palm, a raft and the castaway, with CASTAWAY written on the water; the channel log runs through a 10-hour video in a minute: she nods to the beat, a bottle leaves and comes straight back, a hermit crab becomes walking_coconut, a netsplit takes the sandcastle, and the bot answers !tiers, !sound and !run.
